No Canali registration anywhere. Searched USPTO (Justia; Canali Ireland Limited owner pages list only CANALI / CANALI SPORTSWEAR / CANALI PROPOSTA / CANALI CARE / C CANALI marks) and TMview (37 hits, all offices). The only cl.24/25 register family for this name is Loro Piana S.p.A.: RAIN&WIND SYSTEM, WIPO IR 1001500 (filed 2009-03-11, cl.24+25), plus BR/AR/CO nationals and US 87246457 (ended); Loro Piana also held UK 2056888 'Loro Piana STORM SYSTEM RAIN & WIND PROTECTION' (cl.24/25, expired). Canali PDP presents it with no attribution and no (R)/TM; composition reads only '70% polyester, 30% viscose with membrane'. Standing rule: Loro Piana marks are licensed wherever they appear on a non-Loro-Piana house, so IF Canali's membrane is Loro Piana's this is licensed - but the register does not prove Canali's 'Rain & Wind' is the Loro Piana mark, so recorded as unclear rather than guessed. Certain conclusion: it is NOT house-owned.

No register entry in any office. USPTO 'rain protection' hits are wiper blades, tents, gutters, Carhartt RAIN DEFENDER - nothing Canali, nothing Italian in cl.24/25. TMview cl.24/25 returns 10 hits, none Canali; nearest textile entries are MDB Texinov's Rain'net and Loro Piana's expired UK 2056888 composite containing 'RAIN & WIND PROTECTION'. The phrase is plainly descriptive of a water-repellent finish and would be unregistrable as a bare mark; Canali uses it as a product descriptor (e.g. 'Rain Protection Car Coat'), not a badged technology. Not house-owned, not licensed - just a description.

LOOKED HARDEST HERE - the mill hypothesis does NOT hold. TMview returns exactly 20 worldwide hits for 'impeccabile' across EUIPO, UIBM (Italy), WIPO, UKIPO, OEPM, INPI-BR: none is owned by Canali and none is owned by any Italian wool mill (no Reda, Vitale Barberis Canonico, Marzotto, Guabello, Loro Piana, Cerruti, Piacenza, E. Thomas). The only textile-class entries are TEXITALIA S.R.L.'s figurative 'LIS 1938 - TORINO - ITALIA - LAVORAZIONE IMPECCABILE SIGNORILE' (cl.24/25; UIBM 2010901817918, EUIPO 017215104, UKIPO UK00917215104, WIPO 1039740) - a composite where 'impeccabile' is an Italian adjective meaning 'impeccable', unrelated to Canali. The only cl.25 word mark IMPECCABILE is Spain OEPM M2715303, CONFEXCLASS S.L. (cl.25/35), also unrelated. USPTO (Justia): only the ZAGROSS MARMI marble mark and the same Texitalia composite. Canali's own Anthology page claims it as internally developed ('Canali has developed its most popular product line'; 'Born in 2015'), credits no mill or supplier, and uses no (R)/TM. Verdict: house-named and plausibly house-developed, but UNREGISTERED - so origin cannot be verified from the register. Not licensed from a mill on this evidence.

USPTO 'EXT EXTREME-TEX', serial 79289577, reg. 6465653, status 700-Registered, filed 2020-06-16, registered 2021-08-31, classes 18/24/25 (incl. waterproof clothing); WIPO IR 1540845 with priority 2020-01-27. Owner is PRADA S.p.A. itself - the house operating company, not a subsidiary or licensor. Clean house_owned. Note the register covers the NAME only; whether the laminate is bought in from a third-party mill is not something the register answers and no supplier is named on the PDP.

Prada presents it as a brand - the PDP literally reads 'Lined and padded with Graphene(R)' and 'Graphene(R) padding favors the regulation of body temperature'. But no supporting registration exists. USPTO: no bare GRAPHENE mark for padding/insulation/textiles; Prada owns none. TMview cl.22/24/25 (71 hits): the bare word GRAPHENE in cl.25 is held by unrelated parties - HEAD TECHNOLOGY GMBH (Austria 1050/2011; WIPO IR 1098301, cl.25/28 - the racket company), Lunelli (Brazil/Paraguay), plus assorted CN/IN owners; Directa Plus SpA's 'Graphene Plus' (EUIPO 018464604, cl.1/17/24) is ENDED and Directa Plus's live US mark is 'G+' (serial 79239092), not 'Graphene'. Graphene is a generic material name and is not registrable as a bare mark for graphene-containing goods, so the (R) on Prada's page is unsupported. Whatever the padding is, it is an ingredient material Prada did not develop - but there is no register entry to cite an owner, hence unclear rather than licensed.

DESCRIPTIVE AND UNREGISTRABLE - say it plainly. Fidelity Denim owns no such mark. Its only USPTO registration is FIDELITY DENIM, serial 78607976, owned by FIDELITY DESIGN HOUSE LTD. (the house's own company) for denim apparel - nothing for any fabric name. 'PERFORMANCE STRETCH' is registered to three unrelated parties for adjacent goods: BUCKLE BRANDS, INC. (87069435, bottoms/jeans/pants), NAUTICA APPAREL, INC. (78847861, shirts/pants/shorts) and ARCH TEXTILES MANUFACTURE CORP. (88071102, cl.24 functional fabrics). 'PERFORMANCE STRETCH TWILL' matches nothing at all. On fidelitydenim.com it is a Fabric Type facet/label printed under product names in plain caps (e.g. '50-11 - ANCHOR / PERFORMANCE STRETCH TWILL') with no (R) or TM, alongside equally generic labels COMFORT STRETCH, HAVANA TWILL, AIR KNIT, EXCEL PERFORMANCE DENIM. This is a fabric descriptor, not a house technology, and should not earn an ownership step on the dial.
